name: ContactInquiryPanel
description: Contact page inquiry panel with message and book-a-call tabs wrapping the editorial form.
dense: Contact inquiry tabs (message vs book-a-call) wrapping the editorial contact form; parent owns submit state via the messagePanel slot.

usage.description: ContactInquiryPanel is the contact page's inquiry column: a two-tab switcher between writing a message and booking a call. The parent owns the form and its submit state, passing it in as messagePanel (ContactPage passes ContactFormEditorial); packageId preselects a pricing package for booking CTAs deep-linked from /pricing. The message panel anchors at #contact-form for deep links and imperative scroll.

bestPractices.description: Let the parent own form submit state and pass the editorial form in via messagePanel; the panel only owns the tab chrome.
Deep-link the message tab through the #contact-form anchor; booking CTAs elsewhere can preselect a package with packageId.
Don't use it for a standalone form without tab chrome; mount ContactFormEditorial directly.
Don't rebuild pricing package cards inside the panel; that's PricingPageContent's job.
